Image1 is STYLE/architecture reference only, preserve its soft painting, do not copy its room layout. NEW Fuyuki church narthex and side corridor, same building language as reference chapel but a different room. Warm grey stone floor from y48% to bottom, wide clear foreground x25-72%. Four distinct navigable thresholds: broad central arched opening to the chapel at x50%, ground y54%; open side door at x14%, ground y62% to vestry; door on right rear at x77%, ground y56% to modest living quarters; enclosed stone staircase going down on far right at x92%, ground y81%, with a clearly visible ordinary wooden gate at its top, do not draw an endless dark void. Keep each threshold's landing free of objects. Umbrella holder and bench confined x0-8%, notice board on left rear wall x25-35%. Small pointed window, old wooden trim and one amber lantern, diffuse daylight. Soft blended anime background painting for Sinefine, match the approved church reference: warm aged wood, pale stone and softly reflected cool daylight, readable architecture and gentle edges, no harsh white shine, no heavy black outlines, no glossy 3D render, no excessive saturation, no people, no UI or labels. Complete continuous 16:9 room at eye-height three-quarter view, not a floorplan or collage. Clear walking floor and visible actual thresholds.

Kirei Kotomine, mature tall lean man, short tousled dark brown hair, calm serious narrow face, dark eyes, black ankle-length priest cassock, small white clerical collar, simple gold cross necklace, dark trousers and black shoes as in image1. Empty hands in every walking pose, no book that locks his arms. Crucially the cassock hem is above the shoes and follows the alternating legs; passing phases collect the feet under him visibly, hem sways gently rather than freezing a wide stride. Use case: stylized-concept. A production game SPRITE ATLAS on genuinely TRANSPARENT background, clean RGBA alpha, no floor, no cast shadow, no grid/letters/UI. Exactly 6 columns and 4 equally spaced rows, fixed body size and foot baseline per row, whole body from hair to soles safely inside each cell with generous transparent gutters. Match the reference portrait's face, hair and costume, redraw in gentle painted anime style coherent with Sinefine's soft backgrounds, no chibi proportions or thick black outlines. Row1 cells1-4: IDLE facing front, back, LEFT profile, RIGHT profile; cells5-6 completely EMPTY transparent. Row2: SIX genuinely different slow walking phases ALL facing LEFT, not six identical split-leg poses: left heel contact, left flat support with rear right heel lifting, right leg passing under torso with bent knee and feet close, right heel contact, right support with left heel lifting, left leg passing under torso. Clear alternating feet and passing/collected phases, readable heel-to-toe sequence, modest natural stride, slight counter-swing arms, no skating, running or lunging. Row3 SIX distinct walking phases facing FRONT; row4 SIX phases facing BACK. Same character in every populated cell. Native horizontal canvas approx 1536x1024; no overlapping cells, clipped hair, duplicate feet, extra limbs or asymmetrical growth.
